This research focuses on secondary studies that established a link between cognitive science and artificial intelligence (AI) for the development of AI technologies.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Techniques for Mental Health Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The prevalence of mental health problems has prompted investigations into the use of machine learning to tackle the issues. Mental health is a crucial component of an individual’s overall well-being and can be detected and treated early on, significantly improving the quality of life for those affected. This study examines the use of machine learning algorithms to predict mental health disorders using a dataset of self-reported information. Four commonly used machine learning models K-nearest neighbor classifier, logistic regression, random forest and decision tree are compared in terms of their performance. The objective of this study is to compare the performance of these machine learning algorithms on a self-reported mental health dataset and identify the most suitable model for predicting mental health. The challenges faced by the system include the limited size and quality of the dataset, the need for ethical considerations in handling sensitive mental health information, and potential biases in the data .The results of the experiments identify the most suitable model for predicting mental health.

articleTitle: A Novel Japanese Character Recognition Algorithm for Automatic Smart Courseware Generation Tasks
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The efficient recognition and smart analysis of the character is essential for the digital information processing. To deal with the traditional algorithms of the low efficiency or noise-sensitive features, this paper propoes novel Japanese character recognition algorithm for the automatic smart courseware generation tasks. The proposed algorithm has 3 aspects of considerations: 1) The traditional ELM is optimized considering the unsupervised features, to then obtain the fast deep learning network training speed; 2) The proposed OCR method is studied, the pre-processing steps are combined to make the framework complete; 3) The automatic smart courseware generation scheme is integrated as the application. In the experimentation section, the proposed model is compared with the SVM and PCA, the results on accuracy has proven that proposed model is efficient.

articleTitle: Performance of Spectrum Sensing in Different Fading Environments for Cognitive Radios
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Radio spectrum is a very important natural resource and efficient utilization of spectrum increases the QOS of wireless communication systems. Cognitive Radio Technology plays a very important role for proper usage of spectrum having efficient algorithms for spectrum sensing. This study focuses more on Cooperative spectrum sensing in which decision made by fusing the spectrum sensing result of multiple secondary users in a system. Among the different methods of cooperative spectrum sensing like AND/OR, MRC method shows greater efficiency in spectrum sensing. But, Spectrum sensing is greatly influenced by the wireless channel parameters like path loss, shadowing and fading effects.Spectrum sensing can be done by using Machine Learning algorithms and it shows better spectrum sensing results in different fading environments. This study has performed spectrum sensing in different fading environments like Rayleigh, Rician and Nakagami channels, where the fusion result from all the cooperative secondary nodes is calculated by using Support Vector Machine Algorithm. If the different channel effects are considered, the SVM algorithm gave better results for spectrum sensing. Here, simulations are performed with different training data sizes and the performance is studied for each trial using the linear and Gaussian kernels of SVM algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Comparison of X-Masking Models in DFT Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: VLSI technology advancements are rapidly evolving with the growing demands of human lifestyles. With all these advancements the circuit complexity and speeds are also increasing making the circuits even more difficult to test. From time to time various test schemes are being implemented to increase the quality of tests to bring more reliability to systems. Introduction of BIST was a major change in the testing method used till then. With the increase in complexity the occurrence of unknown values also increase. For the same different techniques are used as the presence of ’X’ values significantly degrade the tests and test results. In this design a two stage X-masking model is implemented that is capable of masking the ’X’ states that occur during the test cycle. Mostly in medical and space related systems require high level of accuracy where tolerance methods can reduce the efficiency of these systems. The design proposed here is an X-Masking model that monitors and masks the unknown values that occur during the test phase. The enhanced design is then compared for its utilisation and power consumption with a basic concept model for the masking. In the design scan chains are monitored for the occurrence of unknown values and they are masked using a two layered masking scheme preventing the propagation of unknown values into the MISR. The design is is simulated using Xilinx Vivado 2020.1 and implemented in Basys-3 FPGA board.

articleTitle: Design of Adaptive Equalizer with TLBO and JAYA Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Adaptive equalizer plays an important role in wireless communication. The speed of data transmission depends on the characteristics of the channel. ISI (Intersymbol Interference) is the major obstacle to speed limitation in a channel. so it is a challenge in wireless communication to transfer data at a high speed. Adaptive equalizer supports high speed data transmission in wireless communications by removing an ISI in a channel. The adaptive equalizer automatically adjusts its coefficient as per different variations in the channel. Different soft computing algorithms have been applied for designing adaptive equalizers to achieve better performance and for faster convergence. In this research, two specific parameter less algorithms TLBO (Teaching Learning Based Optimization) and JAYA are applied for adaptive equalization. Error convergence graphs based on the Mean Square Error ( MSE) parameter have been observed for two algorithms for SNR( Signal to Noise Ratio) 10 dB,20 dB, and 30 dB. From the comparison of convergence characteristics, it is observed that JAYA algorithm gives better performance in comparison to TLBO For a distorted channel

articleTitle: Facial Expression Classification using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Classifying facial expressions is a crucial computer vision task having applications in security systems, emotion identification, and human-computer interaction. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have displayed outstanding success in tasks involving the recognition of facial emotions because of their ability to learn hierarchical features from images. This study presents a CNN-based method for classifying facial expressions that makes use of transfer learning and data augmentation strategies to increase the model’s generalizability and precision. This study has obtained a classification accuracy of 97.22% using an online dataset comprising 28079 face photos tagged with seven emotions (angry, disgust, fear, happy, neutral, sad, and surprise). The proposed findings show that CNNs are efficient at classifying facial expressions and may be applied to the design and development of reliable and accurate facial expression identification systems.

articleTitle: Clustering based PDOP Analysis for GPS and NavIC Combined Constellation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)

authors.preferredName: Srilatha Indira Dutt. V. B. S

abstract: In today's world, the satellite navigation system is used for various applications, from tracking objects to missile launching. It can provide specific positioning everywhere in the world with more precise information. Some global navigation systems widely used are the GPS of the United States, the Russian Global Navigation Satellite System, Galileo of the European Union, and the BDS of China. All the satellites under these navigation systems can be used to obtain more accuracy and system stability. However, considering all the satellites can increase the receiver processor cost. So instead, a few satellites can be selected which are capable of producing high accuracy, which can keep the high real-time performance intact.The K-Means clustering algorithm is used in the satellite selection process for GPS and NavIC Integrated Navigation system, which can provide reliable navigation, timing, and positioning services in India using IISC Bangalore data for calculating GDOP values to measure its accuracy.

articleTitle: IoT based Wind Energy System Monitoring for Maximum Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In order to address the growing energy crisis, wind energy is employed as a substitute source of energy. Highly exposed locations are used to build wind farms. Therefore, people must travel to that specific spot to fix small problems as it occurs. It needs a lot of effort and time and has significant financial challenges. The Internet of Things (IoT) idea can be used to get around these constraints. This study proposes a wind energy conversion system (WECS) employing a maximum power point tracking (MPPT) controller with incremental conductance (IC) for maximum power generation. IoT application is used for the system's real-time monitoring, such as turbine speed, wind speed, direct current (DC) bus voltage, amount of generated power and temperature. Additionally, IoT has integrated a wide range of different sensors for measuring wind characteristics. The PIC microcontroller is used in this system and the WECS model is simulated in MATLAB. The proposed IoT based monitoring system proves that it improves monitoring precision, quality assurance, and the reliability of measuring method.

Author Keywords: Peripheral interface controller and Internet of things

articleTitle: Power Quality Enhancement using Dynamic Voltage Restorer in Distributed Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Power quality (PQ) concerns have become a critical for electrical engineers as well as electric power companies. PQ disruptions may cause sensitive equipment to malfunction or collapse, which would shut down the process. Devices like Hybrid power filters, active/passive filters and custom power devices (CPDs) are used to address such PQ difficulties. The most effective and efficient CPD is the Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR) which aims to reduce voltage sags brought on by problems like short circuits or rapid changes in load. By connecting a DVR in parallel with the load, the suggested approach can introduce a compensating voltage to keep the load voltage within safe parameters. This article describes the enhancement of the PQ in the distribution network by DVR. Simulations in MATLAB/Simulink are used to test if the suggested approach works. The suggested technique has the potential to significantly impact the stability and dependability of power systems as a cost-effective option to improve PQ in distributed systems.

Author Keywords: Distributed network and Voltage source inverter

articleTitle: A Novel Intelligent Image Recognition Scheme based on Fully Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: As a deep feed-forward neural network, the convolutional neural network (CNN) model has achieved major breakthroughs in scheme of image recognition. Compared with the traditional classification methods (KNN, SVM, PSO), the fully automatic classification algorithms reply on convolutional network is separated from human identification, which is tedious, and at the same time backpropagation algorithm is used to automatically optimize the model parameters. Inspired by this, the paper proposes the novel intelligent image recognition scheme with the integrations of fully convolutional neural network. (FCNN). To solve the challenge that overall training accuracy of the general model is reduced due to the overfitting phenomenon caused by the commonality of patterns of the image features while training the models, this study introduced the AlexNet. The loss function is improved and optimized, and for preprocessing of the images, the compressive analysis model is integrated. Through the single and comparison tests, the performance of the designed algorithm is tested, and overall speaking, the recognition accuracy is better than the traditional methodologies.

articleTitle: Detection of Flashy Segment in YouTube Videos using Computer Vision Technique to Prevent Seizure in Epilepsy Patients
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Epilepsy is a medical illness that affects roughly 50 million people worldwide, with 3-5% of these people experiencing seizures caused by flashing or flickering lights or specific patterns with areas of light and dark contrast. This condition is referred to as photosensitive epilepsy (PSE). YouTube is a leading video-sharing website that contains video content that often has rapid changes in brightness or contains strong contrasts in spatial patterns that can trigger seizures. It is important to detect such content before it is distributed or displayed to prevent adverse effects on vulnerable individuals. The proposed solution is a browser extension that provides real-time scanning and processing of YouTube videos to detect and disarm potential seizure-inducing segments. The extension is compatible with Chromium-related browsers, including Brave, and is designed to display a warning if epileptic content is present in a YouTube video. The system utilizes computer vision techniques such as OpenCV to detect flashing video content that complies with the CIE 1931 color space, enabling it to skip seizure-triggering segments from YouTube videos.

articleTitle: Delta-Arm Design for Weed Removal
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Weed control has always been a concern because unmanaged weeds can cause significant agricultural damage or reduce crop yield. Weed control and management are critical for producing high-yield, high-quality crops. Technological developments in controlling weeds have a significant impact on agricultural output. The majority of the weeding process is now done by humans using tools or by spraying herbicides. However, the hand weeding is exceedingly uneven and extremely difficult. As a result, manual weeding by labour should be substituted with an automated alternative. Effective weed control systems will assist in managing weeds regardless of the variations in the environment. The delta robot is a parallel manipulative robot with three degrees of freedom that has been frequently employed in manufacturing industries for pick-and-place applications due to its excellent precision and speed. It can also be employed for weed elimination in agricultural fields. Delta robots have a lot of potential for producing weed management solutions that are much more adaptive, even at the plant scale. The delta robot is used in this situation to control the weeds by eradicating them with the help of an end effector. The end effector can be either a spinning drill or a drill or spraying nozzle. Furthermore, the suggested system allows for the modification of the delta arm's end effector depending on the farm field. Weed plants are arranged in random ways in a field. In comparison to other agricultural machines, the delta robot is simpler to control in any other crop field. To get rid of the weeds, users need to input values for the x, y, and z axes. The Delta robot will get rid of the weed in that particular location. Delta robot technology continues to improve and become more effective. As a result, future weeding robots with a delta arm using the proposed design will be more precise and easier to operate in a wide range of crop fields.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of RISC-V based Smart Insulin Pump
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Diabetes is a major problem that occurs in different age group. In medical technology small percent of delay can lead to the several damages. Hence it is very important to reduce the delay and increase the performance. Recent inventions in medical technology leads to the invention of implantable devices which are placed inside the body which are used to monitor, treat many medical diseases. For the efficient functioning of implantable devices, the delay should be less. RISC-V processor, a free open source architecture which consists of only 47 base instructions to execute any function thus reducing the delay and power consumption is used. Hyperglycemia is a condition that results from an excessive rise in glucose levels. If it is not treated, it can cause heart problems, kidney damage, and nerve damage. To overcome this problem insulin is given to the patients. Insulin pump is developed and is already available in the market but the problem with the existing one is consumes more power 0.12 mW. In this research work, RISC-V based smart insulin pump has been proposed to regulate glucose levels by injecting required insulin. This study proposes a design for a smart insulin pump based on RISC-V that uses 90nm technology to save area and power.

Author Keywords: RISC-V (RISC means Reduced Instruction Set Computer and V means 5th Version) processor

articleTitle: Environment Sound Recognition Systems-A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: There are various sounds in the environment, which are produced by multiple sources such as birds, animals, machinery, etc. An Environment sound recognition system (ESRS) detects and categorizes these environmental sounds. ESRS plays a major role in different applications with sound processing such as noise removal, IoT-based systems for sound monitoring, etc. The paper presents simple ESRS models trained on an existing standard environmental sound dataset, freely accessible via the Freesound project. This dataset contains 250000 unlabeled auditory extracts and 2000 short clips representing 50 different basic sound events. Various feature extraction techniques are applied to sound data; the extracted features are then represented using various vectorization techniques so that they can be incorporated into the models. ESRS models are built based on standard Machine Learning(ML) algorithms. Following that, these models are evaluated, tested, and compared.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Mood Disorder Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Mood disorder is often overlooked and there are people who think that mood disorder is "all in your head". As per the record of World Health Organization (WHO), 5% of the adults are suffering from it. If one has Mood disorder, the general emotional state or mood is distorted or inconsistent with various circumstances and interferes with one’s ability to function. Mental illness is still a taboo. People hesitate to consult a health specialist; hence a system is required as an early detection. The primary objective is to improve this situation by designing a user friendly application. In proposed application, condition of the people will be analyzed with the help of standard Mood Disorder Questionnaire (MDQ), Emotion analysis using face detection with the help of image processing in Python and EEG signals. The results received from above mentioned analysis will determine the severity level of mood disorder using machine learning algorithm. Depending on the severity several activities will be given. These activities will include some yoga, games, meditation and exercise. User is suggested to take the above three tests every week to check the progress. In case of high severity, according to user’s location, suggested list of health specialists will be recommended.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Smart Security Key for Knowledge based Authentication
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Ensuring the safety of passwords has always been a paramount concern for online users, however, numerous individuals still become a victim of identity theft due to the presence of multiple attack types such as brute-force, phishing, and dictionary attacks. These attacks can compromise the users' accounts, and dictionary attacks seem to be the most prevalent. To improve security and safeguard the privacy of users, a new methodology is proposed that involves a sophisticated digital key incorporating cutting-edge biometric and fingerprint sensor technologies along with embedded cryptography. This key generates passwords that are distinct and sturdy, which are impervious to cracking, and utilizes the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm to encrypt and decrypt them. This mechanism offers a new means of securely managing passwords with less user intervention and a heightened level of security compared to traditional authentication techniques.

articleTitle: Transfer of Information using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Data sharing is crucial for advancing commercial breakthroughs, scientific research, and public education. But data owners haven't been able to transfer their information due to worries about data protection, costs, and a lack of safe data-sharing options. Several research works have suggested blockchain-based data-sharing solutions as a means of resolving these problems because to its capacity to increase data-sharing process control and transparency. Although there are models for decentralized data sharing, nothing is known about how to motivate these systems to allow for large-scale data sharing. Anyone can investigate several incentive systems for decentralized data-sharing platforms in this research. Several payment methods between data owners and data requesters are automated via smart contracts. By the simulation of incentive mechanisms on a data-sharing platform built on the blockchain, people assess several cost pricing scenarios for the monetization of data. This concept demonstrates that a cost compensation approach for the data owner may balance the overall incentives for all platform participants while quickly covering the cost of data sharing

articleTitle: ZigBee based Appliances Controlling System: Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Automation of appliances is a key factor that plays a major role in easing human life and controlling appliances like light, fans, etc. through the portable device (mobile). It can be easily accomplished by using the internet, but the problem arises where there is no internet or low signals of the internet (ex: highway, War-torn or conflict zones Protected areas such as natural reserves, national parks, highly secure or classified locations, Remote or isolated areas) To automate appliances that don’t have internet connectivity, RF modules like ZigBee or LoRa can be used. Each ZigBee module is connected with a microcontroller (to upload functions) to transmit data wirelessly and end devices have relays and sensors to follow the command or to send the response to the command. A Network topology will be created by the coordinator, routers, and end devices. By use of congestion control avoidance protocol communication between nodes will be set up so that no disturbance will have occurred. RA(random access) protocol is used as the congestion avoidance protocol.

articleTitle: Securing Booth-based Voting System by Integrating IoT and SDN
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Voting is a decision-making process where people choose their own representative. The classical booth-based voting system has been in practice for a long time, where voters visit polling booths and cast their votes. However, this system is vulnerable to various types of errors, which can lead to the manipulation of votes and undermine the democratic process. One common scenario is the possibility of uninvited guests disrupting and destroying the polling booth, despite the presence of security personnel. Creating havoc on the polling booths causes loss of money, time, and votes. To prevent such unwanted situations, a secure booth-based voting system is proposed by integrating various technologies like the Internet of Things and Software-Defined Networking. By this model, IoT-based polling booths will accept votes from the voters, and the SDN controller can monitor the polling booths and accept only the valid votes from the validated polling booths. Moreover, all the votes will be stored in a central database as ciphertext with which destroying the polling booth would not harm the already cast votes and also prevent the disclosure of votes from any potential attackers. The proposed model is implemented using Mininet-Wifi, Mosquitto MQTT, and MySQL, and it gives satisfactory results.

articleTitle: A Web based Vehicle Parking System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In our day today life traffic has become major problem in our society. It is really hard to find a proper parking place for the vehicle. In a parking area there will be a long queue to park our vehicle thus consuming lot of time if people are in a hurry or it is an emergency. To find a proper place to park the vehicle, this study has come up with software solution for parking the vehicle in a secure place and without consuming lots of time for searching a parking space. The proposed idea is really simple like booking tickets for a movie online, just like that using the developed software people can book the required parking slots in any location just by pre-booking the tickets through the proposed application, this helps to avoid parking the vehicles in the roads. The aim of this research work is to develop and implement an automatic parking system to increase the convenience of the public car parking zone as well as collecting parking charges without the interference of humans. The proposed system processes the frame drawn at parking lot and produces the information of the empty car parking spaces. Cars can be allotted a slot based on the availability of parking lot. When the slot is vacant, it is made digitally available and helps the user discover it through the proposed web-based application. In addition to that, it has an infrastructure where people can open our application and book a slot prior to their visit to that place. The main objective of this paper is to give an alternate approach to solve the parking problems that was faced by the peoples, this study discusses about the solutions to solve various problems. The web application with which the users can choose the parking location without any rush in the searching the parking locations and get instant solutions about the parking locations

articleTitle: Accurate Location-based Routing for Emergency Response: A Case Study of an App for First Responders using What3Words
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The timely delivery of emergency medical services is crucial in saving lives, particularly during the "Golden Hour" following a serious injury. Our study examines how different addressing schemes can impact the accuracy of reaching the exact emergency site on time. This paper discusses the comparison between the accuracy provided by GPS and an Alternate Addressing Scheme system (AAS). The potential benefits of using an AAS namely What3words are discussed in this paper.

Author Keywords: Representational State Transfer Application Programming Interface (REST API)

articleTitle: Review on Energy Management for Green IoT in Smart World
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the advance of information and communication Technology, the world endeavors to become smart with the Internet of Things (IoT). IoT has important use in various aspects of human life in which things (e.g., cars, computer watches, buses, mobiles phone, trains) can interconnect intelligently to serve people in a cooperative manner. However, major challenges for smart IoT are energy consumption and the production of large volumes of toxic electrical and electronic waste(E-waste) with carbon footprints. In this regard, the concept of energy management and green IoT emerged as recent research topics to create sustainable IoT for a smart world. This paper reviews existing energy management approaches (Energy Saving, Energy Harvesting, Reducing Greenhouse Effect) to explore sustainable IoT for making the world smarter, eco-friendly, and sustainable. In addition, related work with application, challenges, the goal of green IoT(GIoT), energy taxonomy, and future research towards energy efficiency and sustainable IoT is discussed.

articleTitle: PCDA Model for Prediction and Analysis of Post COVID-19 Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A novel corona virus explored in an outbreak of viral pneumonia in all the countries. As we all know that in current living scenario COVID-19virus has created havoc and due to this mayhem, it has affected many countries. The virus has also gone through various mutations leading to the second and third wave as pandemic in several countries. Apart from this, those who have already recovered are still facing severe health issues due to post complications of COVID. In this paper we have tried to analyze various postCOVID-19 diseases and their after effects. As we know that current scenario different diseases and biomedical infection affect the human body and after COVID 19 the chance of this infection occurs in doubling ratio rapidly. So that author tries to find the ration percentage and optimal solution to detect the chance of these diseases using machine learning algorithm such as EM.

articleTitle: Optimization Analysis of Photovoltaic Power Generation Integration and Dynamic Characteristics in Micro-Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Through the fast and sustainable advances of the new energy technologiess, main requirement of the existing photovoltaic power generation is accurate photovoltaic output power, which can effectively avoid phenomenon of photovoltaic abandonment or power shortage after the theoretical output configuration, and more meet the actual situation of the system operation. Then, this paper conduct the optimization analysis of the photovoltaic power generation integration and the dynamic characteristics in micro-grid. This study mainly considers the grid-connected operation strategy and then introduce the DC-DC converters to increase the robustness of model. Optimization of the storage system is also considered at the same time. The extensive experiments are performed on lab collected data, and the proposed model outperforms competitors by a significant margin to from the perspective of stability.

articleTitle: Finding an Optimal Route Path for Ambulance
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The first worry in emergency situations is how to get to the scene of the occurrence in the shortest amount of time. In such circumstances, we are most in need of a guide to assist us in locating the ambulance vehicles to the nearest hospitals. This study introduces a new type of web application, which helps to reduce deaths caused by road accidents. The proposed application has introduced a voice recognizer, which can acknowledge the speech and share the details of the nearest hospitals which suits best according to the emergency through a message containing the exact longitude and latitude of the hospital. This study has used python as the programming language within this the speech recognition technique is used for recognizing the client request and Geocoders for obtaining the latitudes and longitudes of the nearest hospital.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Cybersecurity Technique for Detection of Upcoming Cyber Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Cyberattacks are prevalent in the age of the Internet. Each year, both the quantity and severity of cybercrimes increase. Protection against cyber-attacks has become a primary responsibility, Significant in the internet society of today. However, providing cyber security is a highly difficult task that requires experience in the field of attacks and the ability to evaluate the possibility of threats. The continual evolution of cyberattacks is the biggest challenge in this industry. This article describes the significance of cyber security and enumerates the hazards that exist in the present digital environment. The statistics and evaluation of cyberattacks demonstrate the seriousness of these occurrences. Several sorts of cyber security threats are outlined, along with the machine learning approaches that may be used to detect these attacks.

articleTitle: U-slot Loaded Half-Circled Microstrip Patch Antenna Analysis using XGBOOST Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Half-circled U-slot loaded antenna is studied using the HFSS and Machine Learning (ML) algorithm. The proposed work is for predicting the resonance frequency of the U-slot loaded antennaby providing the dimensions of the antennas. The proposed antenna is designed for Wi-MAX application with operating frequency of 3.4 GHz. The HFSS tool is being used for designing and analyzing fractal antennasand generating the training data. Parametric analysis of the designed U-slot-loaded half-circled antenna is developed by altering the half-circle radius, length of the U-slot and width. The data set is then given to theXGBoostML algorithm for training the model. The XGBoost contains remarkably high processing speed and contains features like parallelization, cache optimization, and out-of-core computation which makes the perfect algorithm for predicting the resonance frequencies.U-slot loaded half-circled antenna offers a substantial size reduction, a wide impedance bandwidth, and a uniform radiation pattern on all sides.

articleTitle: Student Engagement Detection in Classroom using Deep CNN-based Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In a large classroom, tutors or self-directed learning systems can more easily manage or summarize the situation by detecting and measuring students' attention levels. Today, many institutions are capable of developing effective systems for assisting teachers or tutoring systems. Deep learning is a sophisticated technology in machine learning. This article suggests a transfer learning technique that may be used to classify student activities in the classroom using a limited dataset. Proposed contribution includes creating a lightweight dataset with a small number of images for each category, which can be used for classification work. In comparison to other studies, the experiments yielded satisfactory results for action recognition with high accuracy. In this work, a system that can automatically detect threats. And also want to the classification of student engagement from images using create a CNN and Mobile Net with multiple layers namely convolution, pooling, flattening, and full connection. This model achieved an overall accuracy of 93% in detecting student engagement. Proposed model is also evaluated on a separate test set that included unseen images and achieved comparable results.

articleTitle: Iris based ATM Transaction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The ability of iris recognition systems to establish reliable biometric security measures in a range of high-risk industries, such as aviation, border enforcement, and defence, has been demonstrated. The banking and financial industries must use this system to that dependability and benefits in cost-cutting and process streamlining. The technology was new initially, but because of the pressures on the banking industry engendered by declining earnings, it became crucial. By offering a paperless and secure banking environment, the deployment of biometric ATMs based on iris recognition technology has made significant progress in improving customer experience. A biometric system will automatically identify the individual based on any form of identifying attribute or attribute that the individual has. A biometric will automatically identify each individual user. In the modern world, there are an expanding range of human operations and transactions whereby fast and precise personal identification.

articleTitle: MANET’s Node Secure Mobility Predictions using Enhanced Adaptive Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Predicting node mobility in dynamic environments is crucial to designing and implementing ad hoc networks. This study presents a filter-based computing approach. Each node's mobility prediction model predicts its neighbors' movements. It uses node spatial and temporal properties. This research suggests using reinforcement learning to increase model accuracy. The greeting message threshold determines the best neighbor node-finding strategy. HP-AODV and ROMSG are used to assess the paper's performance. The proposed welcome message broadcasting algorithm is far cheaper than others. It reduces neighbor node discovery errors. This strategy improves ad hoc wireless network quality. Mobility prediction model integration into the network layer is complex. However, application-level integration may improve routing protocol efficiency. The study develops a mobility prediction framework to anticipate a wireless device's future position reliably. The mobility prediction model is a sequence of discrete occurrences, such as a node's upcoming position, based on its present location. The research suggests using the AdaBoost algorithm and Markov model to increase accuracy. AdaBoost estimates model weight coefficients. The AdaBoost-produced multi-order Markov model beats conventional Markov models.

articleTitle: An Efficient Method for Inductive Power Link Transmission in Low Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This study explores the working principle of inductive connections from a circuit perspective. An electric circuit model is used to compute the induced currents and voltages throughout the sending and receiving coils of an inductive connection. This study discusses about how magnetic resonance is employed in inductive links and how it might help them work better. It will be necessary to analyze the electromagnetic link and determine when energy is efficiently transferred between all components using a specific circuit model that allows the electromagnetic link to be recognized by a comparable reflected resistance.

articleTitle: A Novel Data Acquisition Board for Heterogeneous Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Landslides, especially those induced by heavy rainfall, are one of the leading natural disasters in the world, causing millions of dollars in damage every year. All over the world, several systems have been deployed to monitor and provide early warning of landslides. These systems typically employ distinct types of environmental and geotechnical sensors, which are mounted on the surface of the earth and underground and are usually a combination of analog, digital, and mixed-signal sensors, which can be single-ended or differential. Data from these heterogeneous sensors must be collected using customized electronics since off-the-shelf electronic boards are not directly compatible with these varied requirements. This study has custom designed its own interface boards as part of the data acquisition system of the proposed Landslide Monitoring and Early warning model deployed in Kerala, and Sikkim, India. This study describes some of the complexities involved in designing such a system and the various approaches involved in it. After performing extensive testing and validation, this study has deployed these boards at field locations, and successfully collected the data over the last few years.

articleTitle: Dimensionality Reduction Technique for Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Hundreds of adjacent spectral bands are typically present in hyperspectral photographs. The problem with dimensionality arises from the high correlation and redundancy of such high-dimensional data. Prior to conducting additional analysis, such as classifying the land cover and identifying targets, these bands must be reduced. Remote sensing, seed viability analysis, biotechnology, environmental monitoring, food, pharmaceuticals, medical diagnosis, forensics, thin films, oil, and gas are just a few of the fields and technologies where the HSI is extensively used. The dimensionality issue can be solved and the size of the hyperspectral data is reduced effectively with feature extraction. So, the primary goal of the research is to use feature extraction and dimensionality reduction to lower the dimensions of the hyperspectral images that portray the image. This will facilitate the use of machinery to categorise various classes.

articleTitle: A Low-Cost IoT based Navigation Assistance for Visually Impaired Person
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The Smart Shoe is an adaptive technology that can significantly improve the accessibility and comfort of living for individuals who are visually impaired. The proposed system presents a promising solution to address the challenges faced by visually impaired individuals in daily life. This system aims to assist visually impaired individuals with mobility and navigation by designing a Smart Shoe that can detect obstacles in their path. The shoe utilizes IoT technology and incorporates various sensors such as Ultrasonic, IR, Gyroscopic, and Accelerometer, along with a Microcontroller (ESP32), battery, and vibration motor. The shoe also has a battery that powers the system, making it independent of any external power source. When an obstacle is detected, the shoe sends a warning signal via voice command and vibration to the user via app. The app includes automated voice commands, which are sent to wireless headphones when an obstacle is detected. This feature makes it easier for visually impaired individuals to navigate and move around more independently. The system is portable, lightweight, easy to use, and affordable. This technology improves the accessibility and comfort of living for visually impaired individuals, enabling them to move around more safely and independently.

articleTitle: Analyzing IoT Temperature Sensor Application on IBM Bluemix Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The next wave in the era of computing will be outside the realm of desktop computing. In the IoT paradigm, objects surrounding us will communicate and share information. Advanced sensor technologies used in IoT will give rise to new challenges of generating an enormous amount of data that must be processed, transferred, and presented quickly and efficiently. To make the vision of IoT a reality, high-end computing devices are needed. So, cloud-based processing is required because cloud computing provides low-cost, on-demand, and high-availability computing. As an example, this research study considers the scenario in which machines and servers become overheated after a long period of operation and enter a beyond- threshold temperature state, resulting in machine damage. So, the machine’s temperature needs to be looked at to make sure nothing dangerous happens. To solve this issue, this study has developed an IoT application that is evaluated in IBM Bluemix cloud that would sense the machine’s temperature under analysis and display the appropriate message based on whether that machine is beyond the threshold temperature or not. This, in turn, will help the system administrator prevent dangerous device conditions.

articleTitle: Misbehavior Detection in the Internet of Vehicles using Machine Learning based Situation Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: To improve communications network efficiency, situation identification is essential. The requirement for real-time scenario identification of vehicular communications is growing more pressing provided a certain vehicle movement makes vehicle interaction circumstances vibrant and that there are significant variations in signal propagation, vehicle speeds, and vehicular concentrations among possible situations. On the other hand, it has been demonstrated that cryptography methods are less effective at preventing insider attacks that originate inside the automotive communication network. A misbehaviour detection system has been found to be more effective in identifying and preventing insider attacks. This research study presents a misbehaviour detection system based on machine learning and is learned utilizing datasets produced by numerical simulations in a genuine vehicular distributed system. Vehicle communication systems may choose the proper spatial multiplexing and system integration by correctly detecting the current conditions in order to maintain an efficient and reliable operating condition. A back-propagation neural network (BPNN) is trained, and a scenario identification model is developed, using datasets that comprise channel properties acquired from channel measurements in various scenarios. Additionally, the proposed identification model's best performance-enabling model configuration technique is analysed and offered. The identification accuracy is then verified using validation information from the relevant circumstances.

articleTitle: Text Emotion Detection using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Text Emotion determination is becoming more vital with every passing day as millions of text messages are released on a daily basis. In text analysis, the challenge lies in interpreting the ambiguity of human language, particularly when it comes to emotions. A study was carried out to detect the emotions classified into six categories as anger, fear, joy, love, sadness, and surprise. The algorithms, including Logistic Regression, Linear Support Vector Machine, and Random Forest were used for detecting and classifying the emotions. A comparative study of these methods was carried out by considering two features namely Term Frequency- Inverse Document Frequency and Count Vectors. The highest accuracy was obtained for the Count Vectors feature using the Logistic Regression method and the emotions in the text were classified accordingly.

articleTitle: The IoT Solution for Reliable Transformer Condition Monitoring and Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The power system plays an important role in the development of the country and helps in the growth of each sector. In today’s world, Electricity is considered one of the most important aspects that are required for the world to work properly. The main component in the Power System is a Transformer that helps in the power distribution through the conversion of voltages from high to low and vice versa. To keep the flow of electricity smooth and in proper distribution, the Transformer must work properly without any sort of failure. If any failure occurs, the result will be, a disruption of power flow causing damage to the transmission circuit, inconveniences for the consumers, and as the Transformer is made up of a combination of many small circuits, it will result in an increase in the cost of repair, and also resulting in the reduction of Transformer’s life. So, it has become necessary to keep in check the parameters of the Transformer unit, to save it from a tragic failure, and help allow a smooth and undisrupted power flow. The main challenge faced by the current technological equipment is that it is not compact and cost-effective. Although it provides precise information about the parameters, it is not easily feasible. The main aim of this research work is to develop a compact and cost-effective model that can be effectively put to work in areas that are difficult to be monitored daily. The study proposes the design and imposition of an online electronic Wi-fi system to monitor and record key parameters of a Transformer, like currents, voltage, and temperature. The obtained parameters are processed and recorded in the system memory. The stated wi-fi-based Transformer Health Monitoring System (THMS) will help the transformers to operate smoothly and identify problems before the occurrence of any tragic failure. Any change in the parameters of transmission is sensed to protect the entire transmission and distribution. The performance of the prototype model developed is tested at the laboratory for monitoring various parameters like transformer Over voltage and Under voltage, Over current and Under current, Over temperature, etc.

articleTitle: Review of Cardiovascular Diseases: Causes and Future
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease has become one of prominent concern in relation to the health aspects being the largest individual reason for mortality around the world, not just CVD, but its symptoms too may degrade the health at a high level and may become fatal for a person. CVD isn’t one problem, rather a pack of a few hazardous injuries as well as diseases affecting the vascular system (system of human heart and blood circulatory vessels). These are the primary factors and at the same time, internal diseases of the body or the blood vessels of the middle and brain. In general, the major concerns related to such issues have been recorded in the lateral life, when they cross the age of thirty till, they turn forty-four, although in the primary stages, by the age of thirty-five, most people who’ll ever get CVD, might have been already got to its first stage or to develop the first set of signs of this disease. Typologies of disease as mentioned, CVD is a group of diseases affecting the system. In this paper, emphasis has been laid on the various cardiovascular diseases along with the geographical data in relation to the spread across the world.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Optical Lens Assisted Mobile Application System for Early Detection of Melanoma
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Melanoma is the fatal form of skin cancer that can prevail anywhere in the body due to the abnormal proliferation of melanin pigment. The early detection of Melanoma is difficult due to the absence of anti-natural symptoms it owns. Normal moles may turn into Melanoma lesions due to many factors. A dermatologist diagnoses melanomas using an instrument called Dermatoscope, which acquires the lesion's image and processes it based on the ABCDE algorithm. This study has fabricated an optical lens system that can capture the lesion's appearance and make it free from pixilation. This lens system is a dual-lens system integrated with a mobile application that can predict the possibility of the mole being a lesion and classify it based on its severity using a Deep ConvNet structure. Using an integrated lens system instead of a conventional dermatoscopy is a cost-efficient method and provides clinical significance to identify Melanoma in its earlier stage. Integrated lens apparatus is handy due to its less complicated nature of construction. This setup's efficiency is measured based on its adaptability, output image quality, and accuracy. Detection time and efficiency of the system is assessed using a renowned clinician analyst.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsiness-Detection System based on Transfer Learning and MC-KCF
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The driver fatigue is an important issue in many vehicle accidents. According to a study by Transport Research Wing, drowsy driving causes more than 1 lakh crashes, 71 thousand injuries, and nearly 2 thousanddeaths each year in India.Earlier approach methods are based on AlexNet, GoogleNet, MobileNet and Dricare technique (SqueezNet) and uses video images to identify the driver's state of fatigue, such as yawning, blinking, and the length of eye closure, without fitting their bodies with gadgets. The main challenges faced in implementing earlier approach is image classification and increase in percentage error rate when a greater number of layers are added.The proposed method is based on the issues in connection with the driver drowsiness detection and alert device. The proposed algorithm uses the features of deep convolutional neural network-like RESNET (Residual neural networks) and MC-KCF (Multi Convolution neural network-KCF). These techniques are used to detect driver drowsiness by measuring through eye closure and eye rotation. The proposed method helps in better image classification and produces low percentage error rate.

articleTitle: Enhanced Deep Learning Architectures for Spectrum Sensing in Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The expansion of 5G technologies and the Internet of Things (IoT) increases the demand for spectrum efficiency. In future smart city and Industrial IoT (IIoT) applications, the number of wireless users and IoT devices will be excessive. The effect will be spectrum congestion. Moreover, the existing wireless technology has security flaws and inadequate service quality. Cognitive Radio (CR) technology intends to enhance the functioning of the existing system and meet the growing bandwidth needs of users. Spectrum awareness with identification of various signal patterns, is crucial in a cellular system environment. In this work, two deep neural network architectures are presented to distinguish 5G NR (new Rradio) signals from Long-Term Evolution (LTE) signals. This paper presents AlexNet and SqueezeNet architectures for the classification of NR signal with LTE signal. The analysis is conducted by training the classifiers with three distinct optimizers, including RMSprop (root mean squared propagation), ADAM (adaptive moment estimation) and SGDM (stochastic gradient descent with momentum), In addition, performance study is conducted at three distinct training frequencies to assess the classifiers’ superiority.

articleTitle: Intelligent System for Landscape(ISI) Integrated with Optimized Scene Segmentation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Efficient image segmentation with the integration of the scene understanding is essential for the computer vision application, and using GANs to realize the unsupervised training and data augmentation is one of the current research hotspots. In this study, the novel intelligent system for the landscape (ISI) integrated with optimized scene segmentation algorithm is designed and tested. For the designed algorithm, 3 novelties are considered, namely: (1) Novel GANs based image segmentation algorithm is designed, the multimodal image segmentation based on conditional random field deep convolution generation adversarial network (DCGAN) is considered; (2) The novel YOLOv3 based scene understanding model is designed to construct the intelligent system; (3) The landscape image features are combined to make the model more efficient. The experimentation is conducted and the segmentation performance is validated to be efficient.

articleTitle: Design of Mechanisms of on Board Communication in a 1U Nanosatellite
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Mechanisms of On board communications such as Beacon signal of the satellite, Burn wire mechanism, Uplink, downlink and Proof of life receiver antennas for 145MHz, 866 MHz and 433 MHz is proposed. The Proof of life Beacon signal through Morse code in HAM frequency voicing "VJITSAT" for every 90sec was also designed. Simulations of Uplink antenna, down link antenna and 3 Element Yagi Uda Antenna for different frequencies on 4nec2 antenna simulation software was also performed. It was found that the designed antennas are omni directional with high gain. A timer based burn wire mechanism was also proposed. The Proposed ideas were also implemented using Hardware. All the Mechanisms and Antenna design pertaining to 1U cubesat were simulated and verified through hardware design.

articleTitle: Movie Endorsement to Deliver Top-N Recommendation for User using CoFiTor Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The objective of top N recommendation is to recommend to each user a minor set of N items from a huge group of items based on past dataset on the user's preferences. It provides appropriate recommendations for a user to improve the shopping experience. With the help of this approach users can choose items quickly from a shorter list of suitable products. A lot of current video streaming website recommendation systems do not take individual user's shopping behavior into account. In this research study, a transfer to rank approach that mockups a user's behaviors by simulating the user's shopping processes is considered because this approach has been shown to be better than other state-of-the-art methods. A novel and comprehensive recommendation framework termed coarse-to-fine transfer to rank (CoFiToR), which is a major extension of the most recent work known as transfer to rank, is used to achieve this method (ToR). The proposed approach able to produce more relevant product recommendations for each and every user. As an improvement, the product description can correlate the behavior data in all three stages to generate the recommendation list.

articleTitle: School Bus Monitoring and Security System using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In present times safety and security of students is a major concern to the parents and the school administrations. In this concern, many technologies are rapidly evolving that provides many real time methodologies. This paper assists a solution by providing a real time monitoring of school bus and security systems using IOT, by which parents can have a track on their children’s location and availability. Obstacle detection and acceleration monitoring is also done using ultrasonic sensors and accelerometer. When a student gets in a bus, the fingerprint verification is done using the fingerprint module which ensures only authorized students enter the bus. The collected information from sensors is updated in a real time web server, where the location of the bus and sensor values are displayed. so that parents and the administration can track the current location of the bus using a website developed. The system will sound an alarm and alert the school administration and parents if any sensor values surpass a typical threshold. A DC motor will also be a part of the system to manage the speed of the bus and a buzzer will notify the driver of any unusual sensor readings. An alert message will also be sent.

Author Keywords: High conductance ultrasonic sensor( HC- SR04r)

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Physical Unclonable Function in Field Programmable Gate Array
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The increasing digitalization of data has necessitated the need for enhanced security to protect sensitive information. Random number generators play a critical role in cryptographic systems by providing the required randomness for their applications. This project aims to design and implement a physical unclonable function (PUF) based true random number generator in a field programmable gate array (FPGA). The proposed method employs the use of Ring Oscillator Physical Unclonable Function (ROPUF) response to generate random numbers. However, the current method has the drawback of outputting random numbers dependent on only two ring oscillators. To overcome this limitation, all ring oscillators are sampled using D flip-flops to obtain a signal of all ring oscillators at a constant time and then XORed, followed by post-processing using a Von Neumann architecture to enhance the randomness of the generated bits. The proposed method considers the delay produced by all ring oscillators, thereby increasing randomness.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of RISC-V based Pacemaker
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Heart failures are highly increasing in modern times, regardless of patients' age or genders. Arrhythmia is a severe cardiac condition that affects roughly 5% of the world's population and causes severe damage to patients and may result in death. There is just one solution to this problem that is to regulate your heart rate. A pacemaker is an implanted medical device, which is already available on the market. However, the existing device consumes more power, ranging from 60 micro watts to 100 micro watts. Here, this research work suggests using RISC-V CPU to minimize power and area. The proposed design of RISC-V based pacemaker is implemented using 90nm technology node. The proposed RISC-V model consumes 4.053223 microwatts when compared with existing pacemaker.

Author Keywords: RISC-V (’RISC’ means Reduced instruction set computer and ’V’ means fifth generation)

articleTitle: A Proposed Approach to Detect Traffic Signs by using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: It is very challenging to predict traffic signs by machine without human intervention. Accidents are becoming more frequent today as a result of improper direction. Automated assistance can reduce these mishaps. For the construction of our object (traffic signs) detection model, A CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) model is utilized. With CNN's assistance, machines can quickly recognize objects and forecast the traffic sign automatically. The classification accuracy of this model for 43 different traffic sign types was 96.02% on average. The major goal of this research is to demonstrate to drivers how to drive safely by anticipating all traffic laws and directions through the machine's instructions. In the future, video processing may add. Moreover, it’s crucial to have a large class size, the ability to predict signs in the dark accurately, and proper direction. In the end, it can be anticipated that this study will bring prosperity to the nation.

articleTitle: Raspberry Pi based Women Safety System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The crime again women are increasing at an unprecedented rate, hence designing and developing safety equipment may function as a rescuer and shield against injury in the event of a danger is absolutely vital. A smart device for women's protection that automates the emergency alarm system by using pressure, pulse-rate, and temperature sensors to detect a potential atrocity automatically via outlier detection is proposed in this research. Without the need for a woman to interact with the system during urgent situations, it identifies and transmits notifications for loved ones with their coordinates. It automatically alerts the relatives and the neighborhood police station of an emergency.

articleTitle: Hardware Time-stamping in Network Time Protocol and NTP to 1PPS Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Network time protocol (NTP) works in client-server mode to synchronize clocks of computer systems in "packet switched networks". NTP is popular across internet, wherein multitude of computers acting as "NTP clients" get time from corresponding "NTP servers", without need to get connected with "GNSS time receivers". By default, NTP is configured to operate in software(s/w) time stamping, which means time stamping of NTP packet happens in "kernel or networking stack". With s/w time stamping mode, NTP can provide an accuracy up to microsecond order. Whereas another timing protocol namely, PTP (precision time protocol) uses hardware time stamping to achieve nanosecond accuracy. In this paper, a novel approach of providing "hardware time stamping" to NTP is introduced to achieve nano-second accuracy. Also, "NTP master-slave test bed" to verify the accuracy achieved is also mentioned.

articleTitle: Insurance Amount Prediction Based on Accidental Car Damage Level using AI
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This document presents a machine learning-based approach for predicting the insurance amount for a car damage claim based on the level of damage caused by an accident. The proposed model uses a dataset of past car damage claims, including the level of damage and the corresponding insurance amount paid out. The dataset is subjected to the application of a number of machine learning algorithms, such as decision trees, random forests, and neural networks. The effectiveness of these algorithms is assessed using a variety of measures, including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The results show that the model achieves high accuracy and F1-score, indicating its effectiveness in predicting the insurance amount based on the level of damage. This proposed approach has the potential to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the insurance claims process, ultimately benefiting both insurance companies and their clients. Insurance companies use a variety of factors to determine the amount of compensation paid out to a customer for a car damage claim. One of the most important factors is the level of damage caused by the accident. However, accurately assessing the level of damage can be a difficult undertaking, as it requires a high level of expertise and experience. To address this challenge, machine learning techniques can be used to build models that can predict the insurance amount based on the level of damage. In order to do this, a model must be trained using past data to identify trends and connections between the severity of the harm and the associated insurance payouts. Overall, insurance amount prediction based on accidental car damage level using AI is a promising area of research and has the potential to benefit both insurance companies and their clients.

articleTitle: RFID-Enabled IoT Asset Management System and Machine Learning Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Asset tracking is crucial in today's fast-paced business environment, but traditional methods are inefficient and prone to errors, leading to revenue and productivity losses. To address this issue, a smart asset tracking system is proposed in this study, which integrates IoT technology, Node MCU, RFID sensors, buzzer, and Tag4 for improved accuracy and efficiency in asset management. The system uses RFID tags to track assets, and the data is processed using two Machine Learning algorithms (Gradient Boosting and Random Forest) for improved accuracy and thereby computing metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, f1 score and error rate and comparing them. The system includes a buzzer to alert personnel in case of asset theft or misplacement. This study provides a detailed description of the system's architecture, operation, benefits, and potential applications in various industries.

articleTitle: FPGA based Fault Analysis for Encrypted Code
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Currently, there is a lot of data being produced due to the proliferation of internet-connected devices and applications, making it increasingly difficult to safeguard and maintain privacy. In addition, the network now includes numerous devices with limited resources, thanks to emerging technologies like the Internet of Things. To tackle this issue, trustworthy cryptographic techniques must be used, and they must be efficiently implemented on resource-constrained devices. To protect wireless networks, hardware implementations of cryptographic techniques are common. These implementations offer strong security performance while minimizing processing and energy costs. However, they are vulnerable to side-channel attacks, unlike conventional systems. Particularly, fault attacks have demonstrated their effectiveness in cracking various strong hardware-based symmetric and asymmetric encryption techniques. Typically, FPGAs cannot incorporate a limitless number of logical resources into a single package, and design optimizations are necessary to achieve optimal performance and resource efficiency within these constraints. Using VHDL, an artificial neural network (ANN) can be implemented on an FPGA.

articleTitle: A Dual-Band Stacked Slotted Circular Patch Antenna for 5G Millimeter-Wave Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this study, a stacked slotted circular patch (stacked SCP) antenna is presented for millimeter-wave (mmWave) applications. Substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) coupling slot is adopted for antenna excitation and two metallized vias are added for impedance matching improvement. A cross slot is etched on each circular patch which has a 45-degree inclination angle with the coupling slot. Dual-band radiation response (24-27.9 GHz and 37.9-44.8 GHz -10 dB |S<inf>11</inf>| passband) can be realized. An antenna prototype is fabricated and measured. The measured results are in accordance with the expected results. This compact antenna element can be easily integrated with the mmWave front end and is a promising candidate for fifth-generation (5G) mmWave applications, since the multiband requirement is presently given more attention for 5G communication systems and so on.

articleTitle: FPGA based Power-Efficient Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Research into GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) acceleration using programmable logic arrays has mostly focused on Convolutional Neural Networks. These studies demonstrate the effectiveness of CNNs in various technical vision tasks, such as feature extraction, image analysis, face identification, and rear cross-traffic alert, amongst many others. As a result, there are restrictions on the times in which the CNN model can be implemented on FPGA, such as the restrictions on the quantity of on-chip memory, the dimensions of the CNN, and the parameters of the model. This work suggests a television commercial and an advanced CNN prototype informed by the basic AlexNet prototype. The proposed architecture uses a Commercial engine, an improved version of the insight separates, and a distinct permutation unit. In addition, the designers provide a GPU integration model that supports the Mish and Rectified linear initiation characteristics. The suggested method has a comparatively high detection accuracy while consuming a relatively little amount of the computer system's resources in contrast to other methods considered to be state-of-the-art. This proposed system is design in RTL Verilog Hardware description language. The proposed system is implemented in Xilinx ISE Design Suite-13.1 for use on Spartan -6 (Target Device). The synthesis tool optimized speed, area, and power.

articleTitle: Classification of Soil Fertility using LVQ and PNN Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The fertility of soil is a critical parameter to be considered before making the cultivation planning in some land as this parameter directly decides the crop productivity. The fertility depends on the presence of nutrients such as N (nitrogen), P (phosphorus), and K (potassium) in the soil. The available soil data of Kumaun, Uttarakhand has been utilized in this research. The soil of this region of Uttarakhand is blessed with a good balance of pH, temperature and moisture, abundance of nutrients, and hence good fertility. The objective of this research is to develop soil classification models using two ANN based techniques viz. LVQ (Learning Vector Quantization) and PNN (Probabilistic Neural Network) in MATLAB. A comparative analysis of both models is also carried out.

articleTitle: Real-time Swimming Posture Image Correction Framework based on Novel Visual Action Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Human action recognition has important applications in the motion detection, timely tracking, and comprehensive behavior analysis. It is a direction of the great scientific research significance in the field of computer vision. This study focuses on analyzing the real-time swimming posture image correction framework based on novel visual action recognition algorithm. To begin with, the body image digitization process is applied. First, this study divides the video into frames, extract the coordinates of the human body frame through the pre-trained CNN and get the annotated images for digitalization, then the marked frontal posture data is preprocessed through the translation and normalization operations. After this, the proposed OF-STH network is applied to finalize the swimming posture image correction framework. In the experiment section, the different angles are tested and the pseudo color image recognition and labeling is also tested.

articleTitle: Enhanced Stroke Prediction through Recursive Feature Elimination and Cross-Validation in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Stroke is the primary cause of morbidity and mortality on a global scale, and early identification of people at high risk for stroke is critical for its effective prevention and treatment. On consuming clinical and demographic data, machine learning algorithms have shown the ability to predict stroke risk. This study developed and evaluated four stroke prediction models based on machine learning: Random Forest, SVM Classifiers, Neural Networks, and Logistic Regression. Various feature selection techniques were implemented, including correlation-based, mutual information-based, wrapper-based, and principal component analysis. Results showed that all four machine learning models achieved high accuracy rates, ranging from 85% to 91%. The Neural Network model had the highest accuracy at 91%. Random Forest had the highest sensitivity and specificity at 85% and 91%, respectively. The study demonstrates that machine learning models may be valuable tools for identifying individuals at high risk of stroke and that feature selection techniques can significantly impact model performance. The findings depict the development of more accurate and effective stroke prediction tools, ultimately improving stroke prevention efforts and reducing the burden of stroke on individuals and healthcare systems.

articleTitle: User Flexible Approach for Autonomous Restaurant Menu Ordering System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Automation systems are everywhere in the workplace, the house, or any sizable sector. Recent automation innovations are also being implemented by hotels and restaurants, which have robots that deliver meals and iPads for taking orders. Customers may easily choose the items using electronic menu cards, which resemble tablets. The presentation of this information will be sent to the restaurant's kitchen. The touch screen or display is primarily kept at the customer's end for different uses, including the menu display. This is coupled with an Arduino Uno to process and communicate the data via an R.F. transmitter to the consumer. The Arduino Uno is interfaced with an R.F. receiver and other parts to process the data received at the kitchen end. The monitor or any comparable display device shows the data. In this way, the old menu and order system is effectively replaced with a computerized one at the kitchen end.

articleTitle: Detection of Asperger Syndrome at Early Stages in Children using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: ASD (Autism Spectrum Disorder) is behavioral and considered to be a developmental disorder found in human beings.
