It includes disorders in brain development, eventually affecting functional brain capabilities. It also affects how a person converses with others and causes problems in interaction and communication. The vast range of symptoms, abilities, and functioning levels in ASD patients is known as the "spectrum." It is essential to diagnose ASD at early stages so that autistic child can reach their full potential.In some cases, parents cannot accept that their child's mental growth is not developing along with physical development. With early diagnosis, children with autism can lead fulfilling and joyful lives through the provision of appropriate medication. Screening tests are used to diagnose this type of disorder but are time-consuming and costly. This research study has employed a convolutional neural network to detect the likelihood of ASD in young children at an early stage. Deep Neural Networks function well in many applications. This study has used Xception and Resnet50 model to predict ASD based on static facial images, especially in children. According to the results obtained, ResNet50's performance is better than Xception in Autism detection.

articleTitle: Use of Artificial Intelligence for Palm Vein Detection-based Personal Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Human identification is based on a variety of distinctive biological traits, such as faces, fingerprints, palm prints, DNA, hand geometries, retina, iris, stride, voice, and signatures. Nevertheless, these biometric qualities are not resistant to counterfeiting and may be readily abused to trick the biometric system. A potential option that has recently caught the attention of many academics is vein pattern-based biometrics. Based on the idea that every person has a distinctive pattern of veins in their body, this vein biometric uses the vein (vascular) pattern of the human being to identify the individual. Hemoglobin in the blood absorbs infrared light rays as they travel through the skin, reflecting vein lines as dark lines and other parts as brilliant. Due to the tiny device size and low cost, the vein pattern picture capture procedure from a human finger is effective and practical, which is why finger vein patterns are frequently used. Identifying various components or extracting and analyzing different features from an image is challenging. In this study, a method for personal identification is presented using both local and global characteristics of photographs of human finger vein patterns. Thus the results can be used for a wide variety of applications.

articleTitle: A Robust Hybrid Cryptosystem based on DNA Steganography
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Cryptography is a major concern in the field of computer networks and security of data. By encoding a plain message using cryptographic algorithms, cryptography converts a plain message into an unintelligible format for humans. The advancement in cryptographic algorithm is a fundamental issue for data transmission in today's world. The field of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) based cryptography offers the possibility of resolving the issue efficiently. The work presents an innovative technique of data encoding using DNA sequence. In the proposed DNA steganography technique, the data is encoded to facilitate in hiding a secret message on a sequence of DNA strand using its bases, namely, adenine (A), guanine (G), cytosine (C) or thymine (T), very easily. This algorithm introduces two rounds of encryption within the DNA sequence. The plain text is converted to ASCII (American Standard Code for Information Interchange) code, which is a 7-bit character code with each individual bit representing a unique character. The proposed technique has been tested using random user input and found to give an index of coincidence (IC) value of 0.28, approximately.

articleTitle: Group Shared Mobility Platform Activated via Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Web sharing is a centralized trust system in order to trust users to establish, track, cancel, fare calculate, etc., the service providers. Any malicious activities performed on a centralized server system or vehicle or riders destroy the fairness of the ride and cause the party discomfort. The drivers are assessed by the riders after the ride has been completed. There can be a malicious driver who can claim reimbursement with a fake complaint and give the driver a poor rating. The current system cannot determine the correctness of both parties' objections and delivers the biased outcome of each objection in accordance with the centralized marketing strategies of the company. In order to ensure fair travel, a workaround that can be blocked is presented. The creation, completion, unrest, or abortion of a ride will be published in the block chain booklet so that the peer-to-peer network is available to all participants. This means that the interconnected credibility structure is managed equally at the same time. In Ethereal secure network as well as the KOVAN test network, that have implemented a prototype, and the analysis is included

articleTitle: A Novel Data Flow Security Protection Algorithm for Digital Media in 6G Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the recent development and practice of the homomorphic encryption, privacy computing, blockchain, quantum computing and other technologies, the safe and stable transmission and analysis of information flow has become particularly important. Under this background, this paper proposes the novel data flow security protection algorithm for digital media in 6G environment. As a logical first step, the watermarking technology is studied. The traditional model is improved with the chaotic coding to meet with the complex scenarios. Then, the statistical encryption algorithm is integrated to fit for the 6G scenario. Furthermore, the novel data flow security protection algorithm is achieve by the integration of the Hamming coding. In the experiment section, the 8, 12, 16, 32, 64, 128 bits scenarios are tested and 128 bits obtain the best performance. Our best model configuration empirically achieved the risk detection accuracy of 99.85%.

articleTitle: Tuning A PID Controller using Metaheuristic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This study describes the difficulties that arise while fine-tuning the PID controllers. PID controllers are used in various systems to keep things stable but finding the right settings can be tricky, especially for complex systems that behave in unpredictable ways. If the controller has not been set up correctly, it can cause the system to become unstable and not perform as intended. Although there are some techniques that have shown promise in the past, they also have their limitations.To tackle this issue, this study proposes a solution that uses metaheuristic algorithms such as Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Genetic Algorithm (GA), and Ant Colony Optimization (ACO). These algorithms are designed to find optimal settings for the controller more efficiently than traditional methods. The objective of this research is to compare how well these new methods are compared to the traditional methods. The results show that the new algorithms are more effective and lead to better performance and stability in the system. This research provides a promising solution to the challenges of fine-tuning PID controllers, especially for more complex systems that are difficult to control.

articleTitle: Optimizing Deep Neural Network for Automatic Number Plate Recognition in Challenging Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The study of automatic number plate recognition, a subfield of computer vision and machine learning, has grown in importance. Parking management, toll collection, and traffic monitoring are just a few of the many uses for automatic number plate recognition devices. However, automatic number plate recognition in difficult situations like dim lighting, bad image quality, and occlusions is still a difficult task. In this study, using the TensorFlow and EasyOCR libraries, a novel deep neural network architecture is suggested for automatic number plate recognition in difficult environments. First, examination of the different automatic number plate recognition challenges and how they affect the effectiveness of the current automatic number plate recognition systems. It is then suggested that a deep neural network design should be used to boost the automatic number plate recognition systems’ recognition accuracy in difficult environments by combining convolutional and recurrent layers. Overall, this study suggests new deep neural network architecture for Automatic Number Plate Recognition (automatic number plate recognition) in difficult environments. To increase recognition accuracy, the proposed architecture combines convolutional and recurrent layers, including a kind of recurrent neural network (RNN) dubbed long short-term memory (LSTM). On an openly accessible dataset, the system’s accuracy was 91% and it was developed using the libraries TensorFlow and EasyOCR. The results of this study could be used in a number of industries, including law enforcement, transportation, and parking administration.

articleTitle: Decentralized Banking Services using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Blockchain based crypto based currencies have made it possible to implement a fund transfer system in a more efficient, hassle-free and secure way. The present banking system contains human intervention at many stages wherein system users can modify bank details, bank balance in a fraudulent way. In the classical banking system, users have to wait for a longer time to deposit and withdraw money. A decentralized banking system allows a user to carry out various transactions and manage one’s own data securely. Thus, a decentralized banking system has no room for fraudulent activities and causes no capital loss. The proposed system has three functionalities: User Wallet, a lending platform and a trading platform. The lending platform consists of market funds of all the tokens from which every user can buy a specific amount of tokens. User wallet contains transaction history along with the amount of tokens sent. The trading platform consists of a live price chart of ZB/Eth Thus, users can borrow or lend money from their home or workplace within moments.

articleTitle: Human Stress Detection on Twitter: A Hybrid Approach using LSTM and Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Stress is a common mental health problem that affects individuals from all walks of life. It can manifest in various forms, such as emotional, physical, or cognitive distress. The detection of stress in individuals is crucial for early intervention and treatment. However, traditional methods of stress detection, such as self-report surveys or physiological measures have limitations. In recent years, a social media platform like Twitter, have become a rich source of data for studying mental health. This study proposes the use of deep learning techniques, specifically the combination of LSTM and 1D CNN, to detect human stress levels from social media posts, particularly tweets. By leveraging Kaggle Twitter datasets alongside of the recent original Tweets, the model was well trained and validated, achieving high accuracy levels in stress detection.

articleTitle: Cyber Attacks in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Users are deterred from moving to the cloud by cyberattacks against it. Data security is currently a shortcoming of cloud computing. Potential dangers to cloud computing include not secured data and inadequate cache security. Before businesses switch to cloud computing, security issues need to be properly evaluated. The goals of this study are to define cloud computing and study the cyber assaults against cloud infrastructure. The reduction of non-technical issues may result in fewer security issues. Nonetheless, servers and services are damaged by cryptography, distributed denial of service, and flooding attacks. This study illustrates cloud computing and the risks to the content and cache. The following stage is to hunt for a remedy when the cloud security issues have been identified.

articleTitle: Review of Da Vinci Surgical System and Haptic Feedback Device for Telesurgery
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: An emerging technology is telesurgery, which also makes use of wireless networking and robotics. It enables surgeons to perform surgery on those special patients who are difficult to reach. This technique benefits both the surgeon and the patient. This approach overcomes the issues like shortage of surgeons, geographic isolation, lack of funding, probable complications, and patient travel requirements. Patients benefit from this technology, which also provides technical correctness and ensures the surgeon's safety. Endoscopic surgical robots, particularly the Da Vinci surgical system, and new concepts and significant changes in the field of surgery techniques have been made possible by the development of minimally invasive surgical instruments. The Da Vinci Surgical System and haptic feedback are the primary topics of this study.

articleTitle: Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) in Autonomous Vehicles: A Complete Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This exhaustive investigation examines the Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) in driverless cars. ADAS is vital to improve the safety and effectiveness of an autonomous car. The research briefs the integration of ADAS components such as sensors, cameras, and radar systems into the vehicle's control system. The work also examines the obstacles associated with the implementation of ADAS technology in driverless cars, including data management, cyber-security, and regulatory requirements. In addition, the study evaluates the advantages and disadvantages of ADAS technology and its influence on the automobile industry's future. The results indicate that although ADAS technology provides considerable benefits, such as enhanced safety and driving enjoyment, there are also potential dangers connected with the usage of autonomous cars that must be addressed.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Rake Receiver using Rayleigh Fading Channel in Terms of Bit Error Rate
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The fastest-growing sector of the communications is wireless communication. Yet, the wireless environment is quite unstable, and fading is the main disadvantage. Several pathways are taken by the signal as it moves from the transmitter end to the receiver end. This causes the transmit signals to be received at the receiver in numerous versions, which results in multipath propagation. There will be variations in the attenuations, phases, and travel delays of each of these signals. By combining them with a Rake Receiver, this issue can be resolved. It is a radio receiver created with the intention of reducing multipath fading’s negative impacts. Rake receiver employs several fingers, sometimes referred as correlators, to individually identify the M strongest multipath components. Each received signal is corrected for delays before being fed to the combiner and equalizer. The weighted outputs of the M correlators are then used to determine demodulation and bit decisions. Using Bit Error Rate, this technique’s performance will be assessed.

articleTitle: Improved Human Detection and Classification using Supervised Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In many applications, surveillance, robots, and autonomous driving, human detection is an essential role. Deep learning techniques have made significant strides in recent years when it comes to quickly and accurately detecting humans. This research proposes a deep learning-based investigation into human detection. This study specifically concentrates on how well YOLO, SSD, and Faster R-CNN perform among other cutting-edge deep learning models for human detection. Using benchmark datasets, these models are assessed and their advantages and disadvantages are considered. Furthermore, by adding contextual information into the detection process, this study suggests a unique method for enhancing human detection accuracy in low-light situations. The proposed tests demonstrate that the proposed strategy outperforms other existing approaches. Aerial picture detection, multi-person detection, and real-time detection are some of the issues and future directions are discussed in the final section. The research findings show how deep learning may be used to perform human detection and offer guidance for further study in this field.

articleTitle: Efficient Artistic Image Style Transfer with Large Language Model (LLM): A New Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the development of intelligent information systems, image style transfer technology has been widely known. However, many image style transfer methods can only target one style, which is inefficient in application. In this study, the novel efficient artistic image style transfer with LLM is proposed. To be gin with the study, the related single style transfer models are reviewed to serve as the background. Then, the novel image demosaicing is designed to serve as the pre-processing for the complex images. As the core of the model, novel style transfer algorithm is proposed with the LLM. The novel neural network organization is designed and the core functions are optimized. Furthermore, to validate the performance, the visualzied style transfer test is conducted and the numerical simulation results on the efficiency is tested.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based Healthcare Chat Bot System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Machines are becoming capable of performing tasks like humans in this age of Artificial Intelligence. The most vital as pect of living a healthy life is health care, and the most difficult aspect is finding a doctor's consultant. Everyone cannot afford to visit a doctor for every health issue. The objective of the proposed research work is to design or build a Healthcare chat bot in AI to assist in determining the patient's health and providing basic information before contacting a doctor, but only for minor issues. Using a medical chat bot will save healthcare costs while also increasing medical knowledge. Chat bots are computer programs that employ AI and ML to connect with people. The chat bot system retrieves the query from the database that the user has requested and makes a judgement based on it before presenting the responses.

articleTitle: Text Classification Into Emotional States using Deep Learning based BERT Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Sentiment analysis, a subset of Natural Language Processing (NLP), has grown in relevance as the modern lifestyles have become more reliant on social media. Emotional expressions include actions, feelings, ideas, and nonverbal cues. Modern approaches for Natural Language Processing (NLP) have their origins in machine learning, notably statistical machine learning. This study introduces BERT, an innovative technique for reading sentiments into written language. This model is a synthesis of motor Bidirectional Encoder Representations From Transformers (BERT) representations. In order to develop its learning algorithm of word semantic representation, this model makes use of the BERT. In line with the language context, a comparison of models found that BERT outperforms the government foundation efficiency given by all the other models in the literature. Opinion mining is a branch of natural language processing that analyses public discourse to gauge public opinion on a product or topic.

articleTitle: AI Enabled Invoice Management Application
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Invoices are a critical part of the financial management process for any business. Invoice management involves generating, processing, and tracking invoices, which can be a time-consuming and error-prone task when done manually. With the advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI), businesses can now automate their invoice management processes to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and make better decisions. This paper reviews recent research and industry developments in AI-enabled invoice management applications, including the use of machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), and computer vision. This study begins by discussing about the challenges of traditional invoice management processes and how AI can address these challenges. Next, reviews the current state of AI-enabled invoice management applications and highlights the different types of AI techniques used in these applications. Finally, this study discusses about the future prospects of AI-enabled invoice management applications and the potential impact of it on businesses.
